prompt: Perform a bounded, read-only review of the supplied fixture. Two public surfaces contain identical-looking thresholds, but callers mutate them independently and one surface synchronizes values into a persistent component. Decide whether to centralize them. Inspect callers, mutation seams, lifecycle, and tests before deciding, and report the exact reason for the decision.

assertions.text: Inspects independent mutation and synchronization seams
assertions.description: The report notices facade-to-worker synchronization and direct mutation of both public surfaces.

assertions.text: Does not equate equal defaults with identical ownership
assertions.description: The decision preserves separate configuration seams or proposes centralization only with compatibility safeguards.
